**Overview:**  
Indah Prima Medical Sdn. Bhd. is a private limited company operating a community pharmacy and health‑supplements business in Kelantan. It was incorporated on 30 April 1993 and has a share capital of RM 500,000. The firm has five directors, with Director 4 owning 75.61 % of the equity, and reports an unqualified audit opinion for the last three years.
